hypotheses.O1_family_rank32_is_substantial: Leave-one-pair-out family output rank 32 reaches at least 0.35 median downstream fidelity to the full MLP3 patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.O2_family_rank32_matches_native_addresse: Family output rank 32 reaches at least the native family-channel fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.O3_family_rank16_is_semantically_specifi: At output rank 16, the family projection exceeds the best wrong-family projection in median on both corpora.
hypotheses.O4_family_rank32_is_semantically_specifi: At output rank 32, the family projection exceeds the best wrong-family projection in median on both corpora.
hypotheses.O5_family_rank16_beats_global: At output rank 16, the family projection exceeds the leave-one-pair-out global projection by at least 0.03 on both corpora.
hypotheses.O6_family_rank32_transfers_ood: TinyStories family-rank-32 fidelity retains at least 75 percent of FineWeb fidelity.
